# jibo-log-client
Client program to forward logs to the cloud server

## Release Process
1) Bump version in package.json
2) npm shrinkwrap
3) git commit -a
4) git tag -a vX.Y.Z -m "version X.Y.Z"
5) git push && git push --tags
6) Remove any files that are not part of the package (temp files, etc)
7) npm publish
8) Update BR2_PACKAGE_NODEJS_MODULES_ADDITIONAL in buildroot config files.
